name: CCCTC-binding factor

function.text: CTCF encodes transcriptional repressor CTCF. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); CTCF-related neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: CTCF mutations have been reported in invasive breast cancer, prostate cancer, and Wilms tumor.
